older_issue_relationships.#945: superseded by #1008 and #1007 once those complete

public_workflow_spine.acceptance_boundary: one published cpk-server-docker drives multiple workspaces through public HTTP and MCP-shaped routes
required_harness_gaps_for_1005: workspace id must become per-scenario rather than a single module constant
runtime authority registration must be reusable from the recursive harness
runtime authority delivery registration must be reusable from the recursive harness
image pull authority registration must stay per workspace
scenario selection must support multiple workspaces in one cpk-server process
cleanup labels must be scenario/workspace scoped
public route/MCP usage must be reported per scenario

workspaces.name: router-blue-green-transition
scenario: deploy hello-blue with HELLO_MESSAGE=Hello from blue
deploy router connected to hello-blue by SocketConnection
assert router returns Hello from blue
transition desired graph to hello-green with HELLO_MESSAGE=Hello from green
connect router active socket to hello-green by graph-derived binding
assert router returns Hello from green
advance current graph only after accepted successful runtime realization
acceptance_contract: ACTIVE_TARGET_URL comes from socket-derived runtime material
safe plan ordering keeps the old path until replacement is ready
known_gaps: the existing hosted script supports router-transition in one fixed workspace; #1005 must generalize it for the multi-workspace harness
stop_conditions: router target must be hard-coded outside graph binding
current graph can advance before accepted success

workspaces.name: multiplexer-primary-observer-delivery
depends_on: #955 or equivalent package-owned observer receipt evidence
scenario: deploy hello-primary
deploy hello-observer
deploy http-multiplexer with primary and observer socket requirements
send request to multiplexer
assert primary response wins
assert observer receipt through package-owned bounded evidence
acceptance_contract: MULTIPLEXER_PRIMARY_URL comes from the primary SocketConnection
MULTIPLEXER_OBSERVER_A_URL comes from the observer SocketConnection
observer proof is not weakened to primary-response-only
observer evidence is bounded and secret-free
known_gaps: hello-server currently exposes live, ready, dependencies, and root message endpoints but no request receipt evidence endpoint
#955 remains required before #1008 unless #1004 follow-up discovers equivalent product-owned evidence
stop_conditions: observer proof requires a shell-only fake observer
observer proof requires direct process inspection
observer request retention would be unbounded
core or operations would need multiplexer-specific logic

workspaces.name: postgres-data-service-secret-retained-data
scenario: import postgres-server descriptor
register runtime authority and delivery
realize postgres-server data-service node
resolve POSTGRES_PASSWORD only through SecretReference at interpreter IO boundary
wait for semantic select-one readiness
teardown ephemeral compute/network while preserving retained postgres-data
acceptance_contract: official Postgres OCI image is digest pinned
select-one readiness is semantic, not TCP-only
retained data is distinct from leaked resources
known_gaps: public hosted stress does not yet include a postgres-only workspace scenario
retained volume audit needs explicit scenario-owned naming and preservation proof
stop_conditions: raw password appears in descriptors, runtime request descriptors, observations, events, read models, logs, route responses, or errors
Postgres realization requires a product-specific Docker branch

workspaces.name: seeded-negative-cases-cleanup-ownership
scenario: exercise public route failures in an isolated workspace
prove graph/product/runtime authority errors fail closed
prove stale approval and stale current graph protections survive the stress harness
run Docker residue audit after scenario cleanup
acceptance_contract: incompatible sockets fail as graph/product language errors
missing runtime authority fails before Docker mutation
missing delivery fails before local Docker socket access
cleanup removes only owned ephemeral resources and preserves retained data
known_gaps: negative cases are not yet gathered into one public multi-workspace harness mode
stop_conditions: cleanup might affect Pottery Factory or unrelated Docker resources
public error leaks secrets or raw endpoints
negative assertion must be skipped or weakened
direct store mutation is needed to manufacture stale state

non_goals: remote Docker runtime authority stress beyond existing recursive TLS evidence
direct child cpk-server graph or activity inspection
product-specific branches in core or operations

#1008: #955 product observer visibility validation or equivalent
#1010: complete public multi-workspace seeded stress smoke

decision.reason: The current hello-server product exposes /health/live, /health/ready, /dependencies, and /, but no bounded request receipt endpoint. The multiplexer observer proof would otherwise collapse to primary-response-only.
decision.reason_1005: Existing public routes and runtime authority/delivery commands are sufficient; #1005 should factor and sequence them, not add new runtime semantics.
decision.reason_1004: This issue records the matrix and current truth only.
